objective: Normalize the twenty fixed public seed-0 source records independently. The platform merges identical entity keys, resolves attributes by source priority, preserves ties and missing identities, and returns the global catalog with provenance.

tasks.title: Normalize SKU-0000-01
tasks.description: Normalize exactly one supplier record into an identity and attribute observation.
tasks.requirements: Process only the supplied record. Use the brand_aliases display value. Model: remove only spaces/hyphens and uppercase; retain suffixes such as S. pack_size is an integer or "N pcs". Do not infer missing identity fields from title. If model is empty/missing use reason missing_model; otherwise if pack_size is null/empty use missing_pack_size. An unresolved result contains ONLY source_sku, source_row (row_id), source, priority (source_priority[source]), entity_id:null, reason. Otherwise return these fields plus brand, model, category, pack_size, attributes, with reason:null. Convert attribute capacity to capacity_gb (decimal TB=1000 GB), length to length_mm (m=1000 mm, cm=10 mm), power to power_w (mW=0.001 W); all resulting numbers are integers. Normalize connector/interface with attribute_aliases, lowercase color, retain other attributes. entity_id = BRAND_UPPER:MODEL:category:packN; append :gbN for storage or :mmN for cables. Do not resolve conflicts with other records; that is platform assembly work.

rules.model_normalization: Uppercase and remove only spaces and hyphens; retain all letters and digits including suffix S.

unit_rules.capacity: decimal: 1 TB = 1000 GB; GB remains GB
